name: Metricool
tagline: Metricool is a social media management and analytics platform that supports all major networks, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and websites. Its AI features include caption generation, best-time-to-post recommendations, and competitor benchmarking. Marketing teams use it to manage all channels from a single dashboard.
